tasks.label: 1. Install Root Dependencies
tasks.detail: Step 1: Install all project dependencies in root directory

tasks.label: 3. Kill Docs Port
tasks.command: $proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080,8081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($proc) { $proc | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output 'Killed process on port 8080/8081' } else { Write-Output 'No process found on port 8080/8081' }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
tasks.detail: Step 3: Kill any process using the docs dev port

tasks.label: 4. Clean Docs node_modules
tasks.command: $target = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'docs\node_modules'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) { $full = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($target); if (-not $full.StartsWith('\\?\')) { $full = '\\?\' + $full }; [System.IO.Directory]::Delete($full, $true); Write-Output 'node_modules permanently deleted (no recycle bin)' } else { Write-Output 'node_modules does not exist' }
tasks.detail: Step 4: Permanently delete docs/node_modules with .NET Directory.Delete, so nothing goes to the recycle bin

tasks.label: 5. Clean Docs Cache
tasks.command: foreach ($name in @('.cache', '.temp')) { $target = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' ('docs\docs\.vuepress\' + $name); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) { $full = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($target); if (-not $full.StartsWith('\\?\')) { $full = '\\?\' + $full }; [System.IO.Directory]::Delete($full, $true); Write-Output ($name + ' permanently deleted (no recycle bin)') } else { Write-Output ($name + ' does not exist') } }
tasks.detail: Step 5: Permanently delete docs/docs/.vuepress/.cache and .temp with .NET Directory.Delete, so nothing goes to the recycle bin

tasks.label: 7. Start Docs Dev Server
tasks.detail: Step 7: Start the VuePress dev server at http://localhost:8080

tasks.label: Full Setup: Install + Build + Start Docs
tasks.detail: Complete workflow: Install dependencies -> Build project -> Kill port -> Clean docs -> Install docs deps -> Start VuePress dev server
